name: clippo-rules-tests
description: Testes das Security Rules do Clippo no Emulator

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-clippo "vitest run --no-file-parallelism firestore.rules.test.ts storage.rules.test.ts"
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix ../functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-clippo "vitest run --no-file-parallelism saveSession.test.ts friendsAndSessions.test.ts updateProfile.test.ts"
